title: MCM Attempt Log
description: Schema for Motor City Math attempt-level event logging. One record per answer submission. Enables misconception detection beyond final scores.

schema_version.description: Schema version — bump when fields are added or removed

session_id.description: Unique session identifier (UUID or timestamp-based). Groups all answers from one sitting.

exam_id.description: Practice exam identifier — matches exam JSON exam_id field

question_id.description: Question ID within the exam — matches q.id field

input_id.description: Specific input field ID (for multi-input questions). Null if single-input.

attempt_number.description: 1-based attempt counter for this question in this session. Resets per question.

value_entered.description: The raw value the student submitted. String for text/dropdown, number for numeric.

is_correct.description: Whether this attempt was graded correct by exam.html

hint_shown_before.description: True if the hint was visible when this attempt was submitted

solution_shown_before.description: True if the full solution was visible when this attempt was submitted

timestamp_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds (Date.now()) when the submit button was pressed

time_on_question_ms.description: Milliseconds elapsed since the question card was first rendered. Null if unavailable.

standard.description: Standard code from q.standard — denormalized for analytics convenience

question_type.description: Question type from q.type — denormalized for analytics convenience
